items.title: Microsoft's new model helps AI agents judge their next move
items.snippet: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a small decision-scoring model. Given a situation, a question and a fixed set of answer options, it returns a calibrated probability for each option. This model is designed for routing, classification, prioritization, verification, and workflow control, making it easier to incorporate decision intelligence into existing applications, agents, and workflows in a secure, trusted environment.

items.title: Diffusion-augmented contrastive learning for diabetic retinopathy severity classification
items.snippet: This paper explores diffusion-augmented contrastive learning methods for improving the classification of diabetic retinopathy severity. The approach leverages generative models to enhance feature representation, leading to more robust and accurate diagnostic tools in medical imaging.

items.title: Designing robot-to-robot interaction to support early-stage engagement in a teleoperated Robot Avatar system with multiple robots
items.snippet: This research focuses on human-robot interaction in teleoperated systems, particularly how robot-to-robot communication can enhance user engagement during the initial stages of interaction with multiple robot avatars. It delves into the dynamics of collaborative robotic systems.

items.title: StoneXAI-Net: An Explainable Weakly Supervised Framework for Kidney Stone Classification, Localization and segmentation from CT images
items.snippet: The paper introduces StoneXAI-Net, an explainable and weakly supervised framework designed for the classification, localization, and segmentation of kidney stones in CT images. This approach aims to provide robust and interpretable AI solutions for medical diagnosis.

items.title: MadsLorentzen / ai-job-search
items.snippet: The job search that runs on your machine. This AI job application framework is built on Claude Code, designed to evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare for interviews. It offers a practical, everyday example of agentic AI in action for job seekers.

items.title: calesthio / OpenMontage
items.snippet: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system. It features 12 production pipelines, over 100 tools, and more than 700 agent skill and production-knowledge files, transforming an AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

items.title: mksglu / context-mode
items.snippet: This repository provides context window optimization for AI coding agents. It features sandboxed tool output, persistent session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks, aiming to enhance the efficiency and reliability of AI coding assistants.

dropped.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
dropped.snippet: Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial IoT devices, like smart ovens and off-brand Android TV boxes. A replicator like this would be challenging to shut down, since there's no centralized point to shut off - though it may be slow (with a doubling time of days). Unlike non-AI malware, it could also figure out unfamiliar devices on its own.

dropped.title: Web Infrastructure for AI Agents
dropped.snippet: Better answers start with better web search. Parallel gives agents real-time access to fresh and relevant context from the web. Search billions of pages, extract key information, monitor changes, and do complex research with cited outputs you can trust in production.

dropped.title: AI agents for MDR
dropped.snippet: Our AI agents dynamically interact with data and systems to execute a specific job based on real-time inputs and context. Powered by AI models like LLM, these agents adapt their behavior based on tasking – a massive upgrade from rigid automated workflows. Our AI agents are specialized, focusing on a narrow set of tasks that they perform flawlessly.
